category: per-GB rotating residential proxy and per-address static ISP proxy (Chinese market)
tier: Dynamic residential per GB with 1 GB to 5 TB packs; static ISP per IP

free_tier.stated: New dynamic-residential accounts can claim 200 MB of dynamic traffic after registration ("现新人注册还可免费领取200MB动态流量"); static products have no free test. Dynamic residential packs: 1 GB at ¥38 (30 days), 10 GB at ¥280 (180 days, ¥28/GB), 100 GB at ¥2000 (365 days, ¥20/GB), 1 TB at ¥15360 (¥15/GB), 5 TB at ¥51200 (¥10/GB). The static ISP order form priced a US Socks5 line at ¥50.00 total for an unstated term, with a 10 yuan coupon shown.
free_tier.notes: The currency is yuan (CNY). The static price of ¥50.00 is shown after a coupon and with the duration and quantity fields unfilled, so the per-IP rate and its term are unverified.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: an address or a traffic pack, not an object

retention.stated: not applicable: addresses and traffic packs, not stored bytes. Dynamic packs expire after 30, 180 or 365 days (the 1 TB pack is marked 长期有效, long-term valid, and the 5 TB pack 不限时长, no time limit).
retention.notes: days is null because no bytes are stored.

egress.terms: Dynamic residential is billed by traffic; no limit on concurrency; static products have unlimited concurrency in theory, with a bandwidth limit per line ("一条线路的带宽是有限的").

interface_detail: Http/Https/Socks5 for both products, delivery protocols for static lines include Socks5, Http(s), Vmess, Shadowsocks, Wireguard and GRE; an API document is published for automated purchase and management.
tooling: Any client that speaks SOCKS5 or an HTTP proxy, reached from a Worker through a relay that dials SOCKS5. An API document (kookeey.com/apidoc) and a help centre exist. That is a note on tooling, not a reason to reject.
chaining: The upstream sees a leased or pooled address. The vendor says the static ISP lines come from carriers directly ("运营商直采资源") and that delivered IPs have a cooling period of over 6 months; no delivered address was seen, so the registration class is unverified.

limits.value: dynamic residential is sold as packs of 1 GB (30 days) to 5 TB (unlimited duration); ¥38 per GB at the smallest pack and ¥10 per GB at the largest
static ISP lines are exclusive for the authorised period and carry a limited bandwidth per line

binding_note: The dynamic product is sold by the GB at prices from ¥10 to ¥38 per GB, so the volume price binds first; the static product is bound by one line and its bandwidth.

identity_cost.detail: unverified: the registration form is rendered by script and could not be read (HTTP 422 from the reader). A national-ID real-name check ("实名认证") exists but is optional: the page says unverified users can still use the basic services, and verification adds free traffic and Hong Kong, Macau and Taiwan resources. Personal verification takes a valid mainland identity card; enterprise verification takes a business licence. Payment by WeChat, Alipay and UnionPay is shown.

reliability_note: The vendor says its static ISP lines block access from mainland-China addresses, so an offshore network is needed to use them. No throughput, ban or replacement measurement was made.
confidence_note: Prices, packs, the free-trial line and the optional real-name check are read from vendor pages on 2026-11-03; the sign-up form, the static term and the delivered addresses were not seen.
price_per_tb_month: not applicable: sold by the GB; CNY 10 per GB at the 5 TB pack and CNY 38 per GB at the 1 GB pack
notes: Named on the Chinese-language forum source as an overseas dynamic residential vendor (a thread about a ¥40 per GB price); the forum is the lead and the evidence is the vendor page. The operator is named in the page footer as a company registered in Guangzhou. The page states 4700万 dynamic residential IPs; no pool size was measured.

extras.rung_note: The dynamic pool changes address; the static product is a registration-class claim at rung 5 that was not looked up.
